core.label: IOX Core
core.description: Shared data model — foundational objects referenced across all modules

parametrix.label: ParametriX
parametrix.description: Parametric cost modelling — build and calibrate cost models from parameters
capabilities: Build parametric cost models from configurable project parameters
Run sensitivity analysis to stress-test cost assumptions
Adjust estimates for risk and confidence levels
Generate estimates to seed or validate a Cost Plan
Calibrate models against historical benchmark data

procurex.label: ProcureX
procurex.description: Tender analysis — manage the full procurement and tendering lifecycle
capabilities: Manage the tender lifecycle from gate review to contract award
Issue and respond to tender queries, drawings and documents
Record meetings, actions, risks, assumptions and NCRs
Track BOQs, addenda and work orders
Assess value engineering items against the cost plan

planx.label: PlanX
planx.description: Cost plan management — develop, issue and maintain cost plans through the project lifecycle
capabilities: Structure cost plans into elemental breakdown areas
Issue and version cost plans as design develops
Maintain alignment between plan structure and project budget
Track cost plan evolution across multiple design iterations

reportx.label: ReportX
reportx.description: Cost report management — track and report contract financials, variations and certified payments
capabilities: Track certified payments against the payment schedule
Record and assess variation orders and early warnings
Provide project and programme-level financial dashboards

placeholderx.label: PlaceholderX
placeholderx.description: Rate and benchmark data management — maintain reference cost data and market rates

parametrix:CostPlan.label: Parametric estimates are produced to populate and calibrate a Cost Plan

procurex:Project.label: Meetings, documents, folders, drawings, actions and transmittals are all organised and tracked at the Project level

procurex:Contract.label: Tender gates, BOQs, queries, risks, assumptions, NCRs, addenda and work orders are all scoped within a Contract

procurex:CostPlan.label: Value engineering items are assessed and recorded against a Cost Plan

planx:CostPlan.label: Cost Plan Areas define the elemental breakdown structure within a Cost Plan

reportx:Contract.label: Certified payments, variations and early warnings are all reported and tracked against a Contract

core.CertifiedPaymentAllocation:reportx.label: Payment Schedule Items in Core are allocated against Certified Payments managed in ReportX

core.CostPlanElement:planx.label: Cost Plan Elements from Core are structured and grouped within Cost Plan Areas in PlanX
